description.value: The study investigated cerebellar gray matter integrity and its associations with cognitive performance across behavioral-variant frontotemporal dementia, semantic dementia, progressive nonfluent aphasia, and healthy controls using voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: This study aimed to establish cerebellar gray matter changes on magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and their relation to profiles of cognitive deficits in FTD subtypes.
